say:3:1910538001:1.text: What's the situation, big guy? You can't do anything about the glowing tide either?

say:3:1910538001:1.male: What's the situation, big guy? You can't do anything about the glowing tide either?
say:3:1910538001:1.female: What's the situation, lady? You can't do anything about the glowing tide either?

say:4:1910538002:1.text: You shake your head, gazing at the shimmering light before you and feeling the faint shudder that crept into your heart when your magic was swallowed by the glowing tide.

say:5:1910538003:1.text: On your journey so far, your magic has hardly ever failed you. Yet there was one time you faced a power you could not withstand...

say:6:1910538004:1.text: On that journey through ancient times, when you stood face to face with the fallen god. Had another deity not fought at your side, your life would surely have ended then.

say:15:1910538010:1.text: We from Kaflan make that same face when we're dead set on sailing into a storm.
say:15:1910538010:1.source_cn: ……卡什澜人决心在暴风雨里出航时，也会做出你现在这种表情。

say:15:1910538010:1.female: We from Kaflan make that same face when we're dead set on sailing into a storm.

say:16:1910538011:1.text: I know I can be too impulsive sometimes.

say:23:1910538016:1.source_cn: 咱的东西没了，是个吊坠……

choice_prompt:24:1910538016.source_cn: 咱的东西没了，是个吊坠……

say:25:1910538017:1.text: Alright, big guy. Help me look.

say:25:1910538017:1.male: Alright, big guy. Help me look.

choice:24:0:1.text: Maybe you dropped it on the way here.

choice:24:0:1.male: Maybe you dropped it on the way here.
choice:24:0:1.female: Maybe you dropped it on the way here.

choice:24:1:2.text: Let's look around here. Take the chance to survey the area.

choice:24:1:2.male: Let's look around here. Take the chance to survey the area.
choice:24:1:2.female: Let's look around here. Take the chance to survey the area.

choice:18:0:1.text: I'll do everything in my power.
choice:18:0:1.male: I'll do everything in my power.
choice:18:0:1.female: I'll do everything in my power.

choice:18:1:2.text: I won't watch you throw your life away. No matter what.
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 无论如何，我不会看着你送死
choice:18:1:2.male: I won't watch you throw your life away. No matter what.
choice:18:1:2.female: I won't watch you throw your life away. No matter what.

choice:18:2:3.text: We should at least say a proper farewell to Coralia.

choice:18:2:3.male: We should at least say a proper farewell to Coralia.
choice:18:2:3.female: We should at least say a proper farewell to Coralia.

choice:14:1:2.text: Not this time. Let's go back and think this through.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 这次真的不行，回去从长计议！
choice:14:1:2.male: Not this time. Let's go back and think this through.
choice:14:1:2.female: Not this time. Let's go back and think this through.

choice:11:0:1.text: Trust me. I'm not giving up.

choice:11:0:1.male: Trust me. I'm not giving up.
choice:11:0:1.female: Trust me. I'm not giving up.

choice:11:1:2.text: Only by striking at the source can we save Coralia.

choice:11:1:2.male: Only by striking at the source can we save Coralia.
choice:11:1:2.female: Only by striking at the source can we save Coralia.

choice:9:0:1.text: Let's go. Even my magic can't affect it.

choice:9:0:1.female: Let's go. Even my magic can't affect it.

choice:9:1:2.text: The barrier won't last forever. We have to go back.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 防护罩不能一劳永逸，我们得回去
choice:9:1:2.male: The barrier won't last forever. We have to go back.
